nodes.rationale: White contacts-and-disclaimer footer; no black back cover.

nodes.rationale: Short insight article (~3 pages): small logo on hero, H1 below image, author sign-off, white legal footer (no black back cover).

nodes.label: Family quarterly-outlook (B)

nodes.label: Family white-paper (D)
nodes.rationale: Long research report, often co-branded: cover + purpose band + TOC; many section openers, stat, table, and infographic panels.
